prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original finished ultra-wide photographic banner for a designer's portfolio, 3:1 landscape, ideally 1536 x 512 pixels. This image is the banner artwork only, NOT a whole webpage, NOT a contact sheet. Full bleed, no outer margin, no rounded outer frame, no watermarks. Exceptional art-directed editorial product photography with realistic device mockups, correct device geometry and faithful interface branding. All major text and product features must fit within the center 88% of the image. The actual project interface described below is the authority for device screens. Creative scene photography is illustrative, not a claim about a real location, product outcome or study. Expanded hover Aurelia Hospitality banner, a DIFFERENT scene and composition from the small terrace strip. A panoramic warm coastal Bali villa interior opening to ocean and infinity pool at golden hour. Left quarter shaded limestone wall with refined ivory serif wordmark 'Aurelia' and smaller 'Come for Bali. Stay for the house.'; open architecture occupies center. Right half two premium black phones, arranged with realistic grounded depth, fully contained in image. One shows the actual Aurelia hero: AURELIA spaced serif white wordmark, villa photograph, white serif/italic headline, cream booking fields, #29483A forest-green action. Second shows the real warm cream stay-discovery interface with photograph of a limestone coastal villa, 'Awan Cliff House', dark green controls and understated Manrope-style sans typography. No invented third-party brands. Tactile teak, sand, limestone and olive, cinematic natural light, sophisticated full 1100 x 370px hero.
